scripts.build:compile: NODE_ENV=development vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development
scripts.build:prod:compile: NODE_ENV=production vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=production vite build --mode production
scripts.build:prod: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=production --target=extension --quiet && bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs check --profile=production --target=extension --quiet && bun run build:prod:compile
scripts.pack:store: bun run build:prod && rm -f yiveno-extension-store.zip && cd ../dist && zip -r ../extension/yiveno-extension-store.zip . -x '*.map' -x '**/.*' -x '*.DS_Store' -x '**/.DS_Store' && echo "Wrote extension/yiveno-extension-store.zip from repo-root dist/ (CWS + Edge · ADR-020)"
scripts.build:watch: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=development --target=extension --quiet && NODE_ENV=development vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run eslint && bun run stylelint
